author: GamingBolt
description:
#DRIVE Rally attempts to bring the 90s-styled arcade racer back to the mainstream, but does it manage to make that as fun as it used to be in a world where the Horizon Festival exists? It doesn’t aim to take on the likes of Forza or Need for Speed, opting for a more simple approach to a familiar sport, but things don’t exactly fall together well enough for this one to be on any list of the best racers out there.

Why do we think so? Well, we’ve spent a fair bit of time with this one, and came away with more than a few reasons as to why that’s the case. If you’re thinking about picking up a copy, we’re here to tell you what to expect if you do. Let’s hop in our rides and hit the road as we talk about a title that tries to deliver a specific kind of experience, but stumbles too often along the way for it to be called a completely successful effort.
title: #DRIVE Rally PS5 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
EMPULSE is a very interesting take on shooters, and we’re quite excited to tell you more about it. From a very frenetic combat loop to some awesome kinetics-based gameplay, there’s a lot to like in how 1047 Games has built the city of Freehold, and given us a ton of ways to get around it when fighting against opposing teams who want nothing more than to take you out of the equation. Oh, and let’s not forget about P.A.I.N.T. Bombs, Holojumps, Jetpacks, and freaking Mechs!

Eager to see if this one’s going to work for you? Join us as we take you through what it’s all about and help you decide if Freehold’s going to be on your calendar later this month.
title: EMPULSE Is a Titanfall-Like Shooter  - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Death Stranding 2 is a game that needs no mention, and for obvious reasons. But why then, do its reported sales numbers not communicate that sentiment? It's a game that’s beloved to all who have played it, ourselves included. And while its commercial numbers might be modest, they’re still quite impressive for any game that’s been released in the past few years.
 
Well, we’ve given it a fair bit of thought, and have a few things to say about the situation. Join us as we revisit Sam’s expansive adventure, and take a look at a multitude of factors that have influenced its journey since it cast a spell on us last year, and might even manage to continue doing so as the years go by.
title: Death Stranding 2 - What The Hell Happened?
